methodology.registryParser: TypeScript compiler AST over every @Deserializable registration under src/fields
methodology.inheritanceParser: Resolved current class ancestry for inherited serializable members and field conversion methods
methodology.callerEvidence: Resolved static call edges from the source-generated API graph; dynamic calls may not appear

primitives.behavior: Passes through serialization unchanged; Cast accepts it only when typeof is string.
Passes through serialization unchanged; Cast accepts it only when typeof is number.
Passes through serialization unchanged; Cast accepts it only when typeof is boolean.

registrations.label: Observable list
registrations.purpose: Stores an ordered, observable sequence with incremental add/remove change intent.
registrations.hydration: Nested values pass through autoObject; document members are represented internally as ProxyField references.
registrations.copy: Copy recursively invokes Copy for ObjectField members and retains referenced document identity.

registrations.label: HTML source
registrations.purpose: Stores authored or imported HTML as a semantically distinct field.
registrations.hydration: The html member is restored as a primitive string.
registrations.copy: Copy constructs a new wrapper around the same immutable string.

registrations.label: Icon token
registrations.purpose: Stores an icon identifier without treating it as ordinary display text.
registrations.hydration: The icon member is restored as a primitive string.
registrations.copy: Copy constructs a new wrapper; script and JavaScript conversion intentionally return invalid.

registrations.label: Formatted text
registrations.purpose: Keeps ProseMirror-compatible structured content and its plain-text projection together.
registrations.hydration: Both serialized strings are restored; editor code depends on them describing the same content.
registrations.copy: Copy constructs a new wrapper around the two immutable string projections.

registrations.label: Reactive computation
registrations.purpose: Extends ScriptField with MobX-tracked evaluation and an optional persisted cache result.
registrations.hydration: Uses the ScriptField repair path; evaluation supplies this, _last_, _setCacheResult_, and _readOnly_.
registrations.copy: Copy returns a new ComputedField and does not recursively copy referenced documents.

registrations.label: Executable script
registrations.purpose: Persists Dash script source, options, captured values, and optional setter behavior.
registrations.hydration: The asynchronous repair path recompiles source and resolves encoded document captures.
registrations.copy: Copy retains compiled script objects, setter script, and raw source according to the class implementation.

registrations.label: Document identity
registrations.purpose: Stores one persistent Dash document: a stable ID plus its typed field map.
registrations.hydration: The constructor receives the stored id; nested fields are repaired and ACL caches are refreshed after hydration.
registrations.copy: Document identity is referenced through ProxyField rather than recursively copied as a nested object.

registrations.label: Collaborator cursor
registrations.purpose: Stores a collaborator identifier, timestamp, and canvas position as one presence value.
registrations.hydration: The nested serializr schema reconstructs metadata and position; later position changes must call FieldChanged.
registrations.copy: Copy constructs another CursorField around the same data object rather than deep-cloning the nested records.

registrations.label: Ink geometry
registrations.purpose: Stores sampled stroke points and derived Bezier geometry for drawing, erasing, and hit testing.
registrations.hydration: A nested point schema restores x, y, pressure, and optional timestamp data.
registrations.copy: Copy follows the implementation’s InkData construction path; inner mutation must notify FieldChanged.

registrations.label: Schema column header
registrations.purpose: Stores a schema column’s label, color, value kind, width, sorting, and collapsed state.
registrations.hydration: Primitive members restore directly; all supported mutators call FieldChanged.
registrations.copy: Copy transfers every serialized configuration member into a new wrapper.

registrations.label: Audio URL
registrations.purpose: Retains the semantic identity of an audio resource while sharing URL storage behavior.
registrations.hydration: Relative paths resolve against the current origin; external and data URLs remain absolute.
registrations.copy: Inherited URLField copy preserves the concrete AudioField constructor.

registrations.label: Prefetched reference
registrations.purpose: Uses ProxyField storage while beginning target hydration immediately after deserialization.
registrations.hydration: Its repair hook reads value, which triggers the normal cached-or-requested ProxyField resolution path.
registrations.copy: Inherited ProxyField copy currently produces a ProxyField rather than preserving the PrefetchProxy subclass.

registrations.label: Lazy document reference
registrations.purpose: Stores only a target document ID and resolves the shared client identity on demand.
registrations.hydration: The repair hook reconnects a cached target when available; the first cold read starts one shared request.
registrations.copy: Copy preserves the resolved target or its fieldId, not a copy of the target document.

registrations.label: Date and time
registrations.purpose: Preserves JavaScript Date semantics instead of flattening time to an untyped string.
registrations.hydration: serializr date conversion reconstructs a Date instance.
registrations.copy: Copy wraps the same Date object; callers needing value isolation must clone the Date explicitly.
